messages.subject: Mansour | Saudi Executive Profile | Mining, Government Relations, ESG & Country Leadership
messages.body:
Dear Mr. Abdulghaffar,

I am sharing my profile for senior leadership mandates in Saudi Arabia across mining, metals, energy, industrials and government-facing corporate functions.

I serve as Liaison Director, Social Responsibility Department at AGM Inc., part of Zijin Mining Group. My portfolio spans government and regulatory relations, ESG and social performance, corporate and external affairs, stakeholder strategy, strategic partnerships, compliance coordination and executive communications for a major gold-mining operation.

My current exposure also includes a large renewable-energy platform supporting mining operations, with approximately 46-50 MWp of solar and more than 80 MWh of battery storage.

As Managing Partner of Amrop Saudi Arabia and a member of Amrop's Global Board, your work with Ministers, Boards, CEOs and senior decision makers across the Kingdom is closely aligned with the level and market of my next move. Amrop's Saudi Energy & Infrastructure practice also covers Mining & Metals, Renewables and major industrial sectors.

I am targeting Director, Senior Director, Head, Country Director and VP-track mandates across External Affairs, Government Relations, Corporate Affairs, ESG, Sustainability, Strategic Partnerships, Social Performance and Country Leadership. Saudi Arabia is my first GCC priority.

I have attached a Saudi-focused executive CV for confidential consideration and am available on 30 days' notice.

Kind regards,
Ragunauth Ramsaroop
Liaison Director, Social Responsibility Department | AGM Inc.
